name: loft
description: Linux desktop integration for messaging web apps
author: Keith Vassallo <keith@icemalta.com>

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run bundle-preload && npm run bundle-hub-preload && npm run bundle-renderer && npm run copy-assets
scripts.copy-assets: mkdir -p dist/renderer/titlebar dist/assets/icons && cp src/renderer/titlebar/index.html src/renderer/titlebar/titlebar.css dist/renderer/titlebar/ && cp assets/loft.png dist/assets/ && cp assets/icons/*.png dist/assets/icons/ && mkdir -p dist/assets/gnome-shell-extension/icons && cp ../gnome-shell-extension/metadata.json ../gnome-shell-extension/extension.js dist/assets/gnome-shell-extension/ && cp ../gnome-shell-extension/icons/show-window-symbolic.svg ../gnome-shell-extension/icons/hide-window-symbolic.svg dist/assets/gnome-shell-extension/icons/ && cp ../assets/icons/loft-symbolic.svg dist/assets/loft-symbolic.svg
scripts.start: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
scripts.whatsapp: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron . --service=whatsapp
scripts.messenger: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron . --service=messenger
scripts.slack: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron . --service=slack
scripts.telegram: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron . --service=telegram
scripts.element: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron . --service=element
scripts.talk: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron . --service=talk
